name: blog-content-kit
description: Portable, config-driven AI blog + content engine with a self-driving autopilot backend, for Lovable/Vite + React + Supabase sites.

stack.backend: Supabase (Postgres + RLS + Deno edge functions + pg_cron)
stack.ai_gateway: Lovable AI Gateway (LOVABLE_API_KEY) — swap the fetch URL to use another provider

give_aways.extra_dependency: Needs an `enqueue_email` RPC + a transactional email queue (NOT included). Omit this module if you have no email infra.

internal_linking.extra_dependency: generate-page-embeddings needs pgvector (enabled by 0001) + an embeddings provider.

seo_plumbing.notes: og-image renders OG cards for `abm_pages` (an ABM feature) and is optional; keep only with ABM. sitemap reads site_pages (autopilot module) + blog_posts.

modes.full_pipeline: strategy-agent -> upsert content_topics -> generate-headlines -> schedule into content_queue
modes.nightly: generate + publish the next scheduled queue item, then best-effort request-indexing / validate-external-links / (prerender if present)

autopilot.extra_dependency: strategy/headlines/gap read gsc_snapshots. Populate it with a fetch-gsc-data function (needs Google Search Console OAuth) — NOT included. Everything degrades gracefully when gsc_snapshots is empty.
autopilot.notes: The origin project also had a `prerender` function; it was excluded because it hard-codes a marketing sitemap. autopilot calls it best-effort, so its absence is harmless. request-indexing needs Google Indexing API creds to do anything real.

INTERNAL_HOSTS_EXTRA.note: comma-separated extra internal hosts for link validation (e.g. lovable preview domain)

ask_user_when_missing.question: Which Supabase project should this deploy to? (project ref or link the project)
What is the AI gateway API key (LOVABLE_API_KEY)? If you're not on Lovable, which LLM provider should I target instead?
What is the site's canonical URL (e.g. https://yoursite.com)?
What is the site/brand name and one-line description, and who is the target audience? (steers all generated content)
What language should content be written in? (default: Nederlands)
Which optional modules do you want: glossary, give-aways (needs email infra), internal-linking (needs embeddings), autopilot (self-driving cron)?
For autopilot: how often should it publish (e.g. daily 04:00), and is a fetch-gsc-data / Search Console integration available to feed it?
